summary: Short kerb on a main road with no parking and no pull-off.
reasons: Arterial, no parked cars or bays
Kerb meets bush bank, no shoulder

drivers.seclusion: Bush behind the kerb, but a van would stand in the lane of a busy road.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow kerb beside a steep bush bank; no room to pull fully off the lane.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along this kerb and no marked parking lane.

sun_shade: Bush shades the west side from the afternoon sun.
rubbish: Some scattered items in the bush well off the road to the west.
